title: مشروع العنونة البريدية نظام عنونة متكامل يساعد على سرعة الاستعلام والاستدلال والتحكم ويغطي كامل ليبيا
why: Q2: reports Libya Post already applying the postal addressing system and issuing addresses, a unified system intended to cover all Libya (initial 42,000 buildings, 23+ municipalities), with planned GIS, civil-status and commercial-register integration (Q3, Q4).

title: سياسة الخصوصية وشروط الاستخدام لموقع العنونة البريدية
why: Q2: platform states it is owned and operated by Libya Post to create, manage, update, search and locate approved postal addresses, with sharing to relevant government entities (Q4).

title: Libya Launches New Smart Postal System with QR and NFC Technology
why: Q2: reports launch of smart postal code plates, 22,000 installed in phase one, 111,000 targeted in western Libya, later phases Benghazi, Misrata, Sabha (Q3 phased, not nationwide).

title: إطلاق مشروع العنونة البريدية في بلدية بني وليد
why: Q2: Libya Post installing the first address plate in Bani Walid as part of the municipal rollout, for postal delivery (Q4).

title: شركة بريد ليبيا تعلن انطلاق مشروع العنونة البريدية ببلدية غريان
why: Q2: active Gharyan deployment of 10,000-15,000 plates, intended for delivery and future GIS/urban-planning integration (Q4).

title: العنونة البريدية — معاييرنا
why: Q3: numbering standard and stated objective of covering all cities and regions; dense residential areas numbered first (phased).

title: العنونة البريدية — العنوان البريدي «عنوان لكل مكان»
why: Q2: describes an integrated postal-address system for all Libya with postal codes down to each building and lookup, routing and mail-sorting functions (Q3, Q4).

title: العنونة البريدية - LDIL
why: Q2: live open system to search a Libyan postal address on a map, route to it and share with other applications, Libya Post as partner (Q4); launch stated as 2021.
